description: A rendering model that serves an instant build-time static HTML shell while streaming dynamic request-time components into React `<Suspense>` boundaries within the same HTTP response.
The portion of a route tree that does not depend on request-time APIs, including static components and the `<Suspense fallback>` markup for any dynamic holes.
An async Server Component subtree wrapped in `<Suspense>` that awaits `cookies()`, `headers()`, `searchParams`, or uncached data and streams in at request time.
Moving `await cookies()` or `await headers()` out of root layouts and pages into leaf Server Components wrapped in `<Suspense>` so the outer shell remains prerenderable.
Awaiting a dynamic request API in a component that has no ancestor `<Suspense>` boundary, forcing the route (or parent subtree) out of static shell prerendering.
